About Us
Our office is responsible for conducting all elections held in Camden County. Locally, we administer federal and state election laws. Our principal functions include establishing election precincts and voting sites, appointing and training precinct officials, preparing and distributing ballots, voting equipment, canvassing and certifying the ballots cast in elections, and investigating any voting irregularities. We maintain voter registration for Camden County and provide public information on voters and elections.

RESOLUTION OF THE CAMDEN COUNTY BOARD OF ELECTIONS CONCERNING THE COUNTING OF EARLY AND ABSENTEE BALLOTS
On September 15, 2026, the Camden County Board of Elections met at the Board of Elections Office, Camden, North Carolina and adopted the following resolution:
BE IT RESOLVED by the Camden County Board of Elections that:
The Camden County Board of Elections shall meet at 4:30 PM on Election Day, Tuesday, November 3rd, 2026, at the Board of Elections Office at 117 NC Hwy 343 N, Camden, North Carolina to count early and absentee ballots.
Any voter of the County may attend the meeting and observe the count.
The results of the early and absentee ballot count will not be announced before 7:30 pm on that day.
The Camden County Board of Elections shall meet at 10:00 AM on Tuesday, November 10
th
, 2026, at the Board of Elections Office at 117 NC Hwy 343 N, Camden, North Carolina to count supplemental absentees and provisional ballots.
Any voter of the County may attend the meeting and observe the count.
Kenneth Bukantas, Chairman

RESOLUTION OF THE CAMDEN COUNTY BOARD OF ELECTIONS CONCERNING THE SOUTH MILLS PRECINCT VOTING PLACE
Pursuant to authority given by G.S. 163-128 (a) of the General Statutes of North
Carolina, the Camden County Board of Elections has permanently changed the
following polling place for the precinct listed below.
All affected voters will be mailed notification.
On July 14th, 2026, the Camden County Board of Elections met at the Board of Elections Office, Camden, North Carolina and adopted the following resolution:
BE IT RESOLVED by the Camden County Board of Elections that:
The South Mills Precinct Voting Place has been moved from the South Mills Ruritan Club to the South Mills Volunteer Fire Department, 127 Keeter Barn Road, South Mills, NC, 27976. Questions should be directed to the Camden County Board of Elections at 252-338-5530 or
[email protected]
.
